arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# National Defense expenditures (in millions) from Table 4
expenditures = {
    1933: 680,
    1934: 531,
    1935: 689,
    1936: 900,
    1937: 929,
    1938: 1029,
    1939: 1206,
    1940: 1657,
    1941: 6301  # includes urgent ship construction
}

# Calculate year-to-year log growth rates
log_growth_rates = []
years = list(expenditures.keys())
for i in range(1, len(years)):
    prev_year = years[i-1]
    curr_year = years[i]
    prev_val = expenditures[prev_year]
    curr_val = expenditures[curr_year]
    log_growth = math.log(curr_val / prev_val)
    log_growth_rates.append(log_growth)
    print(f"{prev_year} → {curr_year}: {curr_val}/{prev_val} = {curr_val/prev_val:.4f}, ln = {log_growth:.4f}")

print(f"\nLog growth rates: {log_growth_rates}")
print(f"Number of periods: {len(log_growth_rates)}")

# Calculate mean
mean = sum(log_growth_rates) / len(log_growth_rates)
print(f"\nMean of log growth rates: {mean:.6f}")

# Calculate population standard deviation
variance = sum((x - mean) ** 2 for x in log_growth_rates) / len(log_growth_rates)
pop_std = math.sqrt(variance)
print(f"Population standard deviation: {pop_std:.6f}")

# Coefficient of variation = pop_std / mean
cv = pop_std / mean
print(f"\nCoefficient of Variation (CV): {cv:.6f}")
print(f"Rounded to nearest hundredth: {round(cv, 2)}")
EOF
